deduplication.rule: one record per HTTP request: Week 2 ledger attempts (never its top-level last-attempt usage) joined with the wire audit by attempt_id; research-agent calls one record each

corrections.basis: the reported value is the OpenAI-compatible client class LangChain tags; the model name (pricing table) and the configured DeepSeek endpoint identify the billing provider; the original value is kept in provider_reported

deepseek:deepseek-v4-flash.note: deepseek-v4-flash is the vendor's documented legacy alias of deepseek-flash; off-peak / peak by time of day

pricing.method: cost = cache-miss input x input rate + cache-hit input x cache-hit rate + output x output rate (reasoning tokens are part of output); when a response reports no cache split all input is priced at the cache-miss rate; off-peak floor and peak ceiling; ESTIMATES, not billed amounts
